supplements.title: Longitudinal Plasma Metabolomics Guides Dynamic Risk Assessment and Dietary Modulation for Esophageal Squamous Cell Cancer Chemoimmunotherapy.
supplements.summary: Blood metabolite patterns predict esophageal cancer treatment response and specific dietary compounds improve immunotherapy outcomes.

supplements.title: Effects and mechanisms of probiotics supplement on hypertension.
supplements.summary: Probiotics may help lower blood pressure by improving gut health, offering a potential side-effect-free treatment for hypertension.

supplements.title: Discovery of natural apigenin analogues as lysine-specific demethylase 1 inhibitors against tumoral testicular germ cells.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified a natural apigenin compound that inhibits LSD1 protein and effectively stops testicular germ cell tumor growth in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Three novel benzophenones from Mesua caudata (King) Kosterm. and their cytotoxic activity.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated three new compounds from a plant that killed cervical and breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: De novo synthesis of plant polyketide plumbagin in yeast: a platform for sustainable production of naphthoquinones.
supplements.summary: Scientists engineered yeast to produce plumbagin, a plant compound with anti-cancer potential, enabling sustainable large-scale manufacturing.

supplements.title: S-equol producing bacteria: isolation and identification from Albino Wistar rat gut microbiota.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated gut bacteria from rats that produce S-equol from soy, a compound potentially protective against hormone-related cancers.

supplements.title: Breviscapine inhibits the proliferation and immune escape of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cells by regulating JAK2/STAT3/PD-L1 pathway.
supplements.summary: Breviscapine, a natural compound, stops diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cells from growing and hiding from the immune system.

supplements.title: α-Ketoglutarate protects against cartilage damage via epigenetically driven metabolic reprogramming in osteoarthritis models.
supplements.summary: Alpha-ketoglutarate supplements protect cartilage from osteoarthritis damage by restoring metabolic function through epigenetic changes.

supplements.title: Effect Modification by Serum Vitamin A Levels on the Association between Vitamin D and Relapse or Death in Patients with Digestive Tract Cancer.
supplements.summary: Vitamin A levels may influence whether vitamin D supplementation helps prevent relapse or death in digestive tract cancer patients.

supplements.title: Four New Phenolic Glycosides From the Roots of Ilex pubescens and Their Cardioprotective Effects.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified four new compounds from Ilex pubescens roots that protect heart cells from injury in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Two New Naphthoquinone-Naphthalene Hybrid Dimers From a Marine-Derived Streptomyces Species.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered two new compounds from marine bacteria that kill breast and stomach cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Phytoconstituents of Gmelina Arborea as Potential Breast Cancer Inhibitors: LC-MS/MS, Docking, MD Simulations, and In Vitro Evaluation.
supplements.summary: Gmelina arborea leaf extract shows promise against breast cancer by containing compounds that effectively kill cancer cells in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Chemo Profiling and In Vitro and In Silico Exploration of Essential Oils From Stem and Leaves of Boswellia sacra Fluck.
supplements.summary: Boswellia sacra leaf oil shows promise against breast cancer cells while stem oil demonstrates strong antidiabetic and antimicrobial properties.

supplements.title: Screening Key Compound in Ligusticum chuanxiong Hort. for Anti-Parkinson's Disease Based on an Experimental and Computational Framework.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified Senkyunolide A from a traditional herb as a promising Parkinson's disease treatment by targeting inflammatory pathways.

supplements.title: Nutritional, Anti-inflammatory, and in-silico inhibitory Studies of Trametes versicolor (L.) Lloyd and Flammulina velutipes (Curtis) on HER2 breast cancer protein.
supplements.summary: Two medicinal mushrooms show promise against HER2 breast cancer through anti-inflammatory compounds and natural molecules that bind effectively to cancer proteins.

off_label.title: Androgen Receptor Drives Polyamine Synthesis, Creating a Vulnerability for Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: High-dose androgen therapy for prostate cancer boosts polyamine production, which can be blocked with a drug to improve treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: T2R5 Agonist Phendione Decreases Cell Viability and Induces Apoptosis in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
off_label.summary: A compound called phendione kills head and neck cancer cells by activating a taste receptor, offering a new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Regulation of Autophagy and Metabolism in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Involvement of Wnt-β-Catenin Pathway.
off_label.summary: Riluzole stops hepatocellular carcinoma growth by blocking a key pathway that controls cancer cell metabolism and triggers cell death.

off_label.title: Phase 2 Study of Systemic IL-6 Receptor Antagonist ACTEMRA® (Tocilizumab) for the Treatment of Progressive/Recurrent Pediatric Adamantinomatous Craniopharyngioma
off_label.summary: A drug that blocks IL-6 is being tested to treat children with recurrent brain tumors called craniopharyngioma.

off_label.title: A Phase IIa, Placebo-Controlled, Randomized Study of Daily Obeticholic Acid (OCA) to Reduce Intestinal Polyp Burden in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis (FAP)
off_label.summary: A study tested whether obeticholic acid reduces intestinal polyp burden in familial adenomatous polyposis patients.

off_label.title: PLOD2 Promotes Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma Progression in Association With STAT3-Related ERK and AKT Pathways.
off_label.summary: PLOD2 protein drives skin cancer growth through STAT3 signaling, and blocking it with minoxidil slows tumor development.

off_label.title: Retinal Astrocytic Hamartoma in a Child With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Treated With Selumetinib.
off_label.summary: Selumetinib, a drug used to treat neurofibromatosis tumors, unexpectedly shrank a rare eye tumor and restored vision in a child.

off_label.title: Isotretinoin-related adverse sexual and reproductive outcomes: a real-world pharmacovigilance study of the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS).
off_label.summary: Isotretinoin, a common acne medication, may cause previously undocumented sexual and reproductive side effects that warrant further investigation.

off_label.title: Metformin is associated with the suppression of the TNF-α/iNOS/TIMP-1 axis-mediated liver injury and fibrosis secondary to diabetes.
off_label.summary: Metformin protects against diabetes-induced liver injury and fibrosis by reducing inflammatory markers and nitrosative stress in rats.

off_label.title: Oral Administration of Itraconazole Induces M1 Polarization of Tumor-associated Macrophages in Gynecological Cancer.
off_label.summary: Oral antifungal drug itraconazole shifts immune cells in gynecological cancers toward anti-tumor activity.

off_label.title: Targeting mutant VHL-gene results in therapy response in metastatic clear cell carcinoma of rete testis.
off_label.summary: Targeting a mutant VHL gene with belzutifan drug achieved complete remission in a rare metastatic testis cancer patient.

off_label.title: Impact of Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme Inhibitors on Disease Symptoms in Patients with Chronic Myeloproliferative Neoplasms.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors may reduce inflammation-related symptoms in patients with chronic myeloproliferative neoplasms by controlling the overactive renin-angiotensin system.

off_label.title: IGSF9 promotes immunotherapy resistance in colon cancer by orchestrating an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and enables combinatorial targeting strategies.
off_label.summary: IGSF9 promotes immunotherapy resistance in colon cancer; combining MAPK inhibitor Doramapimod with anti-PD-1 therapy overcomes this resistance.

off_label.title: Intralesional bevacizumab injection for symptomatic glomus tumors of the hand: A prospective pilot study.
off_label.summary: Injecting bevacizumab directly into hand glomus tumors reduced pain and may offer an alternative to surgery.

off_label.title: Effect of linezolid combined with N-acetylcysteine on lung function, blood gas and inflammation in patients with severe pneumonia.
off_label.summary: Combining linezolid with N-acetylcysteine improved lung function and reduced inflammation in severe pneumonia patients better than antibiotics alone.

biomarkers.title: Timely Matters: Predictors of Delay in Oral Cavity Cancer Patients Across the Care Continuum.
biomarkers.summary: Study identifies factors causing delays in oral cavity cancer diagnosis and treatment from symptom onset through completion.

biomarkers.title: Bimodal nanobody agents for cancer imaging and potential intraoperative guidance: a systematic review.
biomarkers.summary: Nanobody-based dual-imaging tracers show promise for real-time cancer visualization during surgery with high tumor-targeting specificity and rapid clearance.

biomarkers.title: Targeting ferroptosis in cancer: from mechanistic insights to therapeutic approaches.
biomarkers.summary: Ferroptosis, a cell death process triggered by iron overload, shows promise as a new cancer treatment strategy, especially for therapy-resistant tumors.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in older patients with early-stage triple-negative breast cancer: real-world insights from neo-real/GBECAM-0123.
biomarkers.summary: Older patients with triple-negative breast cancer tolerate immunotherapy plus chemotherapy less well, experiencing more side effects despite similar treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Longitudinal Plasma Metabolomics Guides Dynamic Risk Assessment and Dietary Modulation for Esophageal Squamous Cell Cancer Chemoimmunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Blood metabolite patterns predict esophageal cancer treatment response and specific dietary compounds improve immunotherapy outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Multi-reader evaluation of deep learning-based auto-segmentation of eloquent brain arteriovenous malformation on MRA and white matter tractography in stereotactic radiosurgery.
biomarkers.summary: A deep learning system successfully auto-segments brain arteriovenous malformations to protect white matter during radiation treatment planning.

biomarkers.title: Confounding factors and biases abound when predicting molecular biomarkers from histological images.
biomarkers.summary: Deep learning models predicting cancer biomarkers from tissue images learn confounding patterns, making them unreliable substitutes for molecular testing.

biomarkers.title: Leveraging tissue-resident memory T cells for non-invasive immune monitoring via microneedle skin patches.
biomarkers.summary: Microneedle skin patches combined with immune cell stimulation enable non-invasive detection of vaccine and disease-fighting immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Chloroethylnitrosourea analogue HJ03 overcomes temozolomide resistance of glioblastoma in mice through induction of ferroptosis and apoptosis.
biomarkers.summary: A new drug called HJ03 overcomes temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma by triggering cell death through two mechanisms simultaneously.

biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a natural apigenin compound that inhibits LSD1 protein and effectively stops testicular germ cell tumor growth in laboratory tests.

biomarkers.title: Optimizing bowel preparation for colonoscopy: Updated consensus recommendations.
biomarkers.summary: Updated guidelines simplify colonoscopy bowel preparation with lower-volume regimens and split-dosing to improve patient tolerability for colorectal cancer screening.

biomarkers.title: Axially Polarized O-Fe-N4 Single-Atom Enzyme Drives Clearance of Tumor-Resident Intracellular Microbiota and Potentiates Immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: A new nanozyme treatment clears tumor bacteria and boosts immunotherapy effectiveness when combined with ultrasound and checkpoint inhibitors.

biomarkers.title: Three novel benzophenones from Mesua caudata (King) Kosterm. and their cytotoxic activity.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers isolated three new compounds from a plant that killed cervical and breast cancer cells in laboratory tests.

biomarkers.title: Summary of Research: Elranatamab Fixed Dosing-A Safe, Effective, and Convenient Dosing Approach.
biomarkers.summary: Fixed-dose elranatamab (76 mg) is safe and effective for multiple myeloma patients across all body weights.

biomarkers.title: Impact of neutron sieve therapy for deep site in boron neutron capture therapy using Monte Carlo calculation.
biomarkers.summary: Neutron sieve filters improve dose penetration depth in boron neutron capture therapy for deep-seated tumors by shifting maximum dose 8mm deeper.

trials.summary: A polymer-RNA complex cured virus-induced sarcoma in mice by reprogramming cancer cells into normal cells through epigenetic changes.

trials.title: T cell receptor-engineered T cells targeting the TP53R248Q neoantigen elicit antitumor effects in human cancer models.
trials.summary: Engineered T cells targeting a common TP53 mutation effectively killed cancer cells in laboratory and patient tumor models.
